subject: Re: NovaMed — SKU repackaging & deployment credit options
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SKU repackaging question — adding image-inference SKU mid-contract

Ben — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Quick follow up from our product and procurement teams: we plan to add an image-inference SKU (higher compute per-token) to our platform mid-contract. We currently have an annual commit that ends 2027-12-31. Two asks: 1) can we co-term the new SKU with our existing contract date (i.e., pro-rate to 12/31) and 2) are there deployment/onboarding credits available for a private-edge deployment?

We need a sense of: pricing for the new SKU on an uplift (monthly usage + top-up commit), any volume discount thresholds, and whether Redwood can provide a one-time deployment credit for on-prem installation (we have a 3-site rollout). Procurement also asked for a rough timeline to get pricing into our internal approval system (we ideally need a finalized commercial term by Apr 20). Attaching the draft SOW.

Thanks — Elena
Product Ops | NovaMed

Attachment: NovaMed-SOW-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 240 KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU repackaging question — adding image-inference SKU mid-contract

Elena — really appreciate the clear ask and timeline. High level options below; I can put together a short commercial summary + pro-forma for your AP team by Monday.

1) Co-term + pro-rate: we can co-term the new SKU to your existing 2027-12-31 renewal. For a mid-contract add, we typically pro-rate the remainder of the year and invoice the remainder as a top-up. Will confirm exact proration math in the pro-forma.

2) Discounting: for a true-up top-up commit (>= 25% of current annual committed units) we can offer a tiered uplift discount starting at 7% and increasing to 12% at higher volumes. If NovaMed is comfortable moving that top-up to a 12-month committed add-on (i.e., annualize the top-up instead of simple pro-rate), we can offer an additional 3% on top.

3) Deployment onboarding credit: we can offer a one-time deployment credit to offset Redwood Professional Services or Approved Partner costs. Typical range is $10k–$25k depending on scope. To firm that up I need your deployment runbook (sites, expected hours).

4) Technical compatibility: Grace, can you confirm any special constraints for the on-prem image SKU (quantization/benchmark runs we should be aware of) and whether a staged rollout (site-by-site) can be supported under the deployment credit?

Next steps: I’ll draft a 1‑page commercial summary and attach a pricing csv for your AP team by EOD Monday (Apr 12). If procurement needs earlier, tell me and I’ll prioritize.

Best — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU repackaging question — adding image-inference SKU mid-contract

Ben / Elena — quick technical note from the CS side: we can support a staged three-site rollout; typical sequence is dev -> staging -> prod with a KV cache warm-up period. For the image SKU we recommend the following to keep latency predictable: 1) set a fixed max-seq length for pre-processing, 2) enable prefix KV caching for common image templates, and 3) use the recommended quantized runtime we validated in lab.

If NovaMed wants the onboarding credit to apply to partner hours, we do need a signed SOW that references the credit and an estimate of hours per site. Happy to run a quick scoping call early next week.

Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial summary and pricing (draft) — NovaMed image SKU add

Elena — attaching the draft pricing CSV and the commercial summary in-line below. This is the pro-forma I referenced earlier.

Attachment: redwood-pricing-2027Q2.csv (text/csv)

Commercial summary (draft):
- New SKU: image-inference-heavy (per-1K tokens equivalent billing); baseline list price $0.45 per 1K token-equivalent
- Co-term approach: pro-rate Apr 12–Dec 31 then option to annualize the top-up at a 3% additional discount if you convert to a 12-month committed add-on
- Volume discount tiers (for the top-up portion): 0–25%: 0% discount; 25–50%: 7% discount; 50–100%: 12% discount; 100%+: contact for enterprise tiering
- Deployment onboarding credit: proposed $18,000 credit applied against SOW for partner install (requires SOW reference)
- Billing: pro-rated invoice for remainder of 2027, with option to re-invoice as annualized add-on to align with internal procurement if you sign an amendment by Apr 20

Ask: please confirm whether the team wants a pro-rated only top-up or to annualize the add (we’ll show both numbers in the formal quote). If you want the annualize option, we’ll need a signed amendment by Apr 20 to make the additional 3% discount effective.

Ben
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@novamed.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial summary and pricing (draft) — NovaMed image SKU add

Thanks, Ben — the numbers look sensible. Procurement asked whether the deployment credit can be split across the three sites (we’d like $6k credit per site) and whether Redwood can provide a sample amendment clause language for the SOW so our legal team can slot it into the change order quickly. Also: can you confirm the cutover window for the staged rollout and whether any temporary performance SLOs are available during the warm-up?

We lean toward the pro-rated top-up for now but want to see both line items (pro-rate vs annualize) for our internal review. If the amendment language and split-credit per site are OK, procurement is comfortable with an Apr 20 approval target.

Best — Elena
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial summary and pricing (draft) — NovaMed image SKU add

Ben / Grace — quick internal approval: I approve a one-time deployment credit of $18,000 to cover partner install, and we can explicitly allow it to be split across sites (i.e., $6k per site) in the SOW. We should also include a short amendment snippet that legal can copy/paste: "Redwood will provide a one-time deployment credit of $18,000 to NovaMed; credit will be applied against Partner Professional Services as specified in SOW Addendum A. Credit is non-refundable and must be applied to services within 90 days of amendment effective date."

Ben — you can offer the pro-rate vs annualize numbers; if they annualize and commit to a 12-month add-on, approve stacking the extra 3% discount (so their max stack is the 12% tier + 3% annualize). Please capture this as redlines in the amendment and loop legal if procurement pushes different wording.

Thanks — Jordan
VP, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
